name: viewgum
description: ViewGum's skills and MCP connector for making vertical short videos from an agent, free short video plans for small businesses, and tested FFmpeg and caption tools for vertical video.

plugins.name: viewgum
plugins.description: The ViewGum connector and eight skills: viewgum-shorts (make, edit and export shorts, pricing first) and seven that need no account: deslop-script, hook-check, short-form-script, post-copy, upload-preflight, ai-label-check and short-form-specs.

plugins.name: business-video-skills
plugins.description: Short video plans for twelve kinds of small business (15 ideas and a 30-day calendar), with a claim check against sourced ad and claim rules for each industry. No account needed.

plugins.name: ffmpeg-vertical-video
plugins.description: Tested FFmpeg commands for 9:16 video for TikTok, Reels and Shorts: 16:9 to 9:16, export settings, captions inside the safe zone, compression to a size, loudness and more, each run in CI. No account needed.

plugins.name: short-form-captions
plugins.description: Word timestamps to SRT, WebVTT or ASS captions for vertical video, the ASS inside the safe zone with word highlighting, and a caption checker against Netflix and BBC guidelines. No account needed.

plugins.name: in-this-town-story-skill
plugins.description: Writes In this town and In this world story scripts for vertical shorts: the rule test, the eleven measured beats, seven twist kinds, and a pace and line checker. No account needed.
